section_summary.extract_value: This section details the participants and design of a single study. A sample of 141 college students, predominantly women, with an average age of 19.6 years, participated. The study manipulated task instructions (be creative vs. be fluent) within-person, using two divergent thinking tasks (unusual uses for a box and a rope), with counterbalanced instruction and task order.
